name: Claire Cocrown
source:
A navy officer and a junior of Klaus. She was a friend of Klaus' deceased sister, and has been acquainted with Klaus from an early age and treated him like a brother.
She has a cheerful and friendly personality, and although there are some gaps, she is very good navigator. She has always been secretly in love with her childhood friend, Klaus.
